title: python -m pip install --use-feature=2020-resolver .  results in an error option --use-feature: invalid choice: '2020-resolver' (choose from 'fast-deps', 'truststore','no-binary-enable-wheel-cache')
author: Namasivaayam-L

comments.author: Namasivaayam-L
comments.body:
I kind of found a work around, 

`python -m pip install --use-feature=fast-deps .`

I started to try the alternatives provided by pip itself and found 'fast-deps' works and 'trust-store' doesn't. And I haven't tried 'no-binary-enable-wheel-cache'. 
So keep these in mind.
Hope it helps.
